game.name: Aliens : Colonial Marines (Russia)
game.desc: Aliens: Colonial Marines on Xbox 360 is a first-person game that puts you in the body of an American marine, ready to do anything to face the threat of alien colonisation that is coming. In single player or in cooperation (up to 3 other players at the same time), you will have to use your different weapons to kill the little creatures from elsewhere. Other multiplayer modes are also available for even more green blood on the screen...
